chunks.title: Deutsche Bank (Deutsche Bank) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Deutsche Bank is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in Germany. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: Sustainable finance & ESG investment banking mobilization (€500B+ cumulative sustainable finance framework) covering transition & green capital markets. Source verification: https://www.copbusiness.org/papers/COP31_WG_climate-finance-investments.pdf.

chunks.title: Deutsche Bank Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Deutsche Bank provides the following climate financing instruments: Green Bond Underwriting, Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL), Transition Finance, Blended Climate Fund Structuring. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 400,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary, Municipality.

chunks.title: Deutsche Bank Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Deutsche Bank: Renewable Energy, Industrial Decarbonization, Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Climate-Tech Innovation, Clean Transport. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, Germany, EMEA, Türkiye, Asia-Pacific, Americas. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Deutsche Bank Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Deutsche Bank's application form: Deutsche Bank Sustainable Finance Framework & EU Taxonomy alignment; ICMA GBP / LMA GLP or SLLP verification; Second-Party Opinion (SPO) & audited credit profile; Scope 1/2/3 GHG reporting. Explicit exclusion rules: Thermal coal mining/power expansion. Official application portal: https://www.db.com/what-we-do/focus-topics/sustainability/.

chunks.title: Deutsche Bank Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: Deutsche Bank uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.

chunks.title: Deutsche Bank Guidance for 'Corporate Borrower & Operating Jurisdiction'

Borrower Overview' on Deutsche Bank's Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake: Borrower entity, sector, and primary market. Required=True. Expected evidence keywords: Verified applicant facts. Align response with Deutsche Bank's COP31 priorities (COP31 Business Forum Climate Finance & Investments Working Group member) and instruments (Green Bond Underwriting, Sustainability-Linked Loan (SLL), Transition Finance).
